purpose: App integration qualifications for exact reviewed additional sources; no original manifest or compiled record is rewritten.

decisions.reason: Preserve every previously published compiled observation. A source-compatible complete duplicate comparison has not established replacement; compiled edition labels and legal-employer attribution remain unverified. An accepted official cohort does not establish the reporting period or scope of a compiled copy.
